title: Potala Palace
blurb: The Dalai Lamas’ winter palace on Marpo Ri in Lhasa, begun 1645: the secular White Palace and the religious Red Palace with its eight golden stupas, 13 stories and over 1,000 rooms ringed by battered stone walls.

systems.name: Marpo Ri hill
systems.description: Red Hill and its retaining terraces, some 3,700 m above sea level.

systems.name: White Palace
systems.description: The Potrang Karpo, the secular White Palace completed 1648-1649: living quarters, offices, seminary and printing house.

systems.name: Red Palace
systems.description: The Potrang Marpo, the religious Red Palace of 1690-1694: chapels, the assembly hall and the eight golden stupas.

systems.name: Gilded roofs
systems.description: The gilded bronze pavilion roofs crowning the palace.

systems.name: Perimeter walls
systems.description: The outer walls ringing the 400 by 350 m complex.

systems.name: Gates
systems.description: The pilgrim gates into the complex.

systems.name: Grand stairs
systems.description: The long stair flights climbing the hill to the palace.

systems.name: Courtyards
systems.description: The courtyards before the palace fronts.
